# se standalone program test cases (USalign-beta branch)
# run_test.py appends "-outdir ." to every case, so generated files stay in the
# case working directory and are collected as comparison artifacts.
# Format: <name> <working_dir> <arguments...>
# <working_dir> is relative to the data/ directory
#
# Covers: extracting a sequence alignment from a pair of superposed structures,
# with -u/-d/-a score normalisation options, with -i (alignment-guided), and on a
# real protein pair. se writes only to stdout, so no generated artifacts are
# compared.

se_basic  help    model.pdb native.pdb
se_uda    help    model.pdb native.pdb -u 100 -d 5.0 -a T
se_i      help    model.pdb native.pdb -i align.txt
se_real   help    ../101m.pdb ../1mba.pdb
